title: Hint text for assigning a Playback stream to another device
line: Hovering an app's icon in the Audio Volume widget now says you can drag it onto another device.
explanation: An app's stream can be moved to another output or input device by dragging its icon onto that device, but nothing in the widget told users this; the only hints were the open-hand cursor and a pause-emblem tooltip that appears only for paused streams. Users found out about it from promo videos or not at all. The stream icon now has a tooltip that says to drag it onto another device to play through it (or record from it, for recording streams), shown only when dragging is possible (more than one device). The "Currently not playing" text moved into that same tooltip so the two never overlap.

commits.message:
applet: add a tooltip hint for dragging streams onto devices

Streams can be moved to another device by dragging their icon, but
nothing in the applet said so. The icon's tooltip now explains it, and
the "Currently not playing" text moved there from the pause emblem.

BUG: 365279

patches.diff:
From 27e04c7aec749ad0ee836d19f8703bf9b5a51c27 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 22:55:11 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applet: add a tooltip hint for dragging streams onto devices

Streams can be moved to another device by dragging their icon, but
nothing in the applet said so. The icon's tooltip now explains it, and
the "Currently not playing" text moved there from the pause emblem.

BUG: 365279
---
 applet/ListItemBase.qml | 19 ++++++++++++++-----
 1 file changed, 14 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applet/ListItemBase.qml b/applet/ListItemBase.qml
index 83fab21f..c6fe290b 100644
--- a/applet/ListItemBase.qml
+++ b/applet/ListItemBase.qml
@@ -67,13 +67,22 @@ PC3.ItemDelegate {
                 implicitWidth: implicitHeight
                 source: item.isStream ? "emblem-pause" : ""
                 visible: valid && item.model.Corked
+            }
 
-                PC3.ToolTip.visible: visible && dragMouseArea.containsMouse
-                PC3.ToolTip.text: item.type === "source-output"
-                    ? i18n("Currently not recording")
-                    : i18n("Currently not playing")
-                PC3.ToolTip.delay: 700
+            PC3.ToolTip.visible: dragMouseArea.containsMouse && !dragMouseArea.drag.active
+            PC3.ToolTip.text: {
+                const lines = [];
+                if (item.model.Corked) {
+                    lines.push(item.type === "source-output"
+                        ? i18n("Currently not recording")
+                        : i18n("Currently not playing"));
+                }
+                lines.push(item.type === "source-output"
+                    ? i18nc("@info:tooltip", "Drag onto another device to record from it")
+                    : i18nc("@info:tooltip", "Drag onto another device to play through it"));
+                return lines.join("\n");
             }
+            PC3.ToolTip.delay: 700
 
             MouseArea {
                 id: dragMouseArea
--

media.caption: Master: hovering a playing app's icon shows nothing
With the fix: the icon's tooltip says to drag it onto another device
Master: a paused stream only says "Currently not playing"
With the fix: the paused stream's tooltip has both lines

reviews.text: Good HIG-friendly solution that adds a hover tooltip on the draggable stream icon instead of permanent instructional clutter below the list, and merges the corked "Currently not playing"/"Currently not recording" notice into the same tooltip so tooltips never overlap. It uses proper @info:tooltip i18nc context for the new strings, preserves existing translations for the corked strings, hides while dragging or when only one device is available, and is verified across playing, paused, drag-and-drop, and single-device cases.

Fulfils the wish: the drag-to-move-stream feature now has a visible hint, placed as a tooltip on the draggable icon instead of the permanent instructional line the reporter suggested, which fits the HIG better. It is gated by dragMouseArea.containsMouse, and dragMouseArea.enabled is the existing 'draggable' alias (devicesModel.count > 1 in StreamListItem), so the hint only appears when dragging is possible, matching Nate's comment; it hides during the drag and the 'Currently not playing/recording' text is merged in so the two tooltips can't overlap. Small QML-only change in plasma-pa, screenshots match the captions, commit message and explanation match the diff. Nitpick: the wording could hint that the devices are on the Devices tab (the tab switches by itself once the drag starts, so it works in practice).
